Roadmap Phases: Stabilize & Secure → Probate Petition & Authority → Ancillary / Multi‑State → Dispute / Litigation → Asset + Debt Inventory → Notices & Claims → Tax/Accounting → Distribution & Close
Roadmap Steps (Condensed):
1. Secure property & valuables; prevent loss (locks, insurance, utilities check)
2. Obtain 8–12 certified death certificates
3. Locate key documents (will/trust, deeds, statements, insurance, tax returns)
4. Notify SSA/employer/pension; stop improper payments; identify survivor benefits
5. Forward/monitor mail; cancel subscriptions; freeze/monitor credit if needed
6. Build asset & debt inventory (banks, brokerage, real estate, vehicles, loans, cards)
7. File petition; request appointment (executor/administrator)
8. Obtain Letters + EIN; open estate bank account
9. Serve/publish required notices to heirs/beneficiaries and creditors
10. Inventory assets; obtain appraisals/valuations as required
11. Review/pay approved claims and expenses; keep court-compliant accounting
12. Petition for final distribution; distribute assets; close estate
13. Identify out-of-state assets; confirm ancillary requirements in that state
14. Open ancillary proceeding if needed; coordinate local title transfer/notices
15. Preserve evidence; secure originals of will/trust and key communications
16. Engage probate litigation counsel; consider mediation/settlement strategy
17. Freeze distributions until resolution; expect extended timeline
